mapper.sql: select fun_code, menu_name, parent_id, order_num, path, component, `query`, route_name, is_frame, is_cache, menu_type, visible, status, ifnull(perms,'') as perms, icon, create_time from sys_menu
mapper.select: select distinct m.fun_code, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.path, m.component, m.`query`, m.route_name, m.visible, m.status, ifnull(m.perms,'') as perms, m.is_frame, m.is_cache, m.menu_type, m.icon, m.order_num, m.create_time from sys_menu m where m.menu_type in ('M', 'C') and m.status = 0 and (m.perms is null or m.perms = '' or m.perms not like 'tenant:%') and not exists (select 1 from sys_menu tenant_child where tenant_child.parent_id = m.fun_code and tenant_child.perms like 'tenant:%') order by m.parent_id, m.order_num

select distinct m.fun_code, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.path, m.component, m.`query`, m.route_name, m.visible, m.status, ifnull(m.perms,'') as perms, m.is_frame, m.is_cache, m.menu_type, m.icon, m.order_num, m.create_time from sys_menu m left join sys_role_menu rm on m.fun_code = rm.fun_code left join sys_user_role ur on rm.role_code = ur.role_code left join sys_role ro on ur.role_code = ro.role_code left join sys_user u on ur.user_code = u.user_code where u.user_code = #{userCode} and m.menu_type in ('M', 'C') and m.status = 0 AND ro.status = 0 and ro.role_type = 'PLATFORM' and ro.shop_code = '' and (m.perms is null or m.perms = '' or m.perms not like 'tenant:%') order by m.parent_id, m.order_num

select m.fun_code from sys_menu m left join sys_role_menu rm on m.fun_code = rm.fun_code inner join sys_role r on r.role_code = rm.role_code where rm.role_code = #{roleCode} and r.role_type = 'PLATFORM' and r.shop_code = '' and (m.perms is null or m.perms = '' or m.perms not like 'tenant:%') and not exists (select 1 from sys_menu tenant_child where tenant_child.parent_id = m.fun_code and tenant_child.perms like 'tenant:%')
and m.fun_code not in (select m.parent_id from sys_menu m inner join sys_role_menu rm on m.fun_code = rm.fun_code and rm.role_code = #{roleCode})
order by m.parent_id, m.order_num
select distinct m.perms from sys_menu m left join sys_role_menu rm on m.fun_code = rm.fun_code left join sys_user_role ur on rm.role_code = ur.role_code

select distinct m.perms from sys_menu m left join sys_role_menu rm on m.fun_code = rm.fun_code left join sys_user_role ur on rm.role_code = ur.role_code left join sys_role r on r.role_code = ur.role_code where m.status = '0' and r.status = '0' and ur.user_code = #{userCode} and r.role_type = 'PLATFORM' and r.shop_code = '' and (m.perms is null or m.perms = '' or m.perms not like 'tenant:%')

select distinct m.perms from sys_menu m left join sys_role_menu rm on m.fun_code = rm.fun_code inner join sys_role r on r.role_code = rm.role_code where m.status = '0' and rm.role_code = #{roleCode} and r.role_type = 'PLATFORM' and r.shop_code = '' and (m.perms is null or m.perms = '' or m.perms not like 'tenant:%')
select count(1) from sys_menu where parent_id = #{funCode}
where menu_type in ('M', 'C') and (path = #{path} or path = #{routeName} or route_name = #{path} or route_name = #{routeName})
mapper.insert: insert into sys_menu( fun_code, parent_id, menu_name, order_num, path, component, `query`, route_name, is_frame, is_cache, menu_type, visible, status, perms, icon, remark, create_by, create_time )values( #{funCode}, #{parentId}, #{menuName}, #{orderNum}, #{path}, #{component}, #{query}, #{routeName}, #{isFrame}, #{isCache}, #{menuType}, #{visible}, #{status}, #{perms}, #{icon}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update sys_menu set order_num = #{orderNum} where fun_code = #{funCode}
